findings.title_text: Clause 35 quantitative details depend on stock records that the books alone cannot confirm
limits_text: Clause 35 (quantitative details of principal items) needs opening stock, purchases, sales, yield and closing stock by item; this engine can show the Stock Summary and Trial Balance figures above but cannot certify completeness of the item records, particularly given the typed-in / negative-stock facts above.
ask_client_text: Quantity reconciliation or a stock register maintained outside Tally, if any.

findings.title_text: Stock items carry a negative closing quantity at year end
limits_text: Read directly off the Stock Summary's own closing quantity; a negative quantity is not physically possible, so the item's record is incomplete (an opening balance, a purchase, or a stock-journal entry was not captured in Tally).
ask_client_text: Physical stock record for each item listed, or an explanation of the shortfall.

findings.title_text: Books closing stock and the Tally Stock Summary valuation differ
limits_text: Both figures come from Tally; which one (if either) matches an actual physical count is not something the books can show. With 'Integrate accounts with inventory' off, the accounts use the ledger-entered figure, not the Stock Summary valuation.
ask_client_text: Signed physical stock verification / certified stock statement for both dates.
Bank drawing-power statement, if any cash credit/OD is secured on stock.

findings.title_text: No voucher in the books posts to any Stock-in-Hand ledger
limits_text: The closing-stock figure on the Stock-in-Hand ledger(s) was entered directly (Tally shows no voucher deriving it); how it was arrived at is a client fact the books cannot show.
ask_client_text: Basis of stock valuation (cost/net realisable value, method used).
Signed physical stock verification / certified stock statement.
Bank drawing-power statement, if any cash credit/OD is secured on stock.
